_comment: BorderBridge regulatory knowledge base. Every rule carries sourceCitation and lastVerifiedDate (SRS constraint C2, NFR-ACC-01). Rules are versioned data, never overwritten (NFR-ACC-05). verificationStatus 'needs-verification' causes the UI to flag derived output (NFR-ACC-02, FR-ADM-04). A trained non-developer may edit this file; no code change is required (NFR-MNT-03).

rules.name: National identity card or passport
rules.issuingAuthority: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (Rwanda)
rules.reason: Proof of identity is required of every person crossing the border, irrespective of the goods carried.
rules.sourceCitation: EAC Common Market Protocol, Article 7 (Free Movement of Persons)

rules.name: Commercial invoice
rules.reason: Establishes the transaction value from which customs value, duties and taxes are computed.
rules.estimatedProcessingTime: Prepared by the trader; no lead time
rules.sourceCitation: EAC Customs Management Act 2004, s.39 (entry of goods)

rules.name: Simplified Certificate of Origin
rules.issuingAuthority: Customs officer at the border post
rules.reason: Establishes EAC origin for a consignment moving under the Simplified Trade Regime, so that it enters duty-free. Issued at the border rather than applied for in advance.
rules.sourceCitation: EAC Simplified Trade Regime; EAC Rules of Origin 2015

rules.name: EAC Certificate of Origin
rules.issuingAuthority: Rwanda Revenue Authority / Ministry of Trade and Industry
rules.reason: Required for consignments outside the Simplified Trade Regime to claim EAC preferential (duty-free) treatment. Applied for before travelling.

rules.name: Customs declaration (single administrative document)
rules.reason: Full customs entry is required for consignments that do not qualify for the Simplified Trade Regime.

rules.name: Phytosanitary certificate
rules.issuingAuthority: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
rules.reason: Required for plants and plant products, to certify freedom from pests and disease before export.
rules.sourceCitation: International Plant Protection Convention; EAC SPS Protocol 2013

rules.name: Coffee export licence and quality certificate
rules.reason: Coffee is a controlled export in Rwanda. Shipments require NAEB registration and a quality certificate before leaving the country.
rules.sourceCitation: Rwanda Law on Coffee; NAEB export procedures

rules.name: Veterinary / sanitary certificate
rules.issuingAuthority: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
rules.reason: Required for animal products, certifying that they originate from disease-free stock and were handled to sanitary standards.

rules.name: EAC Simplified Trade Regime value threshold
rules.reason: Consignments of EAC-originating goods below this value, and whose product appears on the agreed common list, are exempt from full customs declaration procedures and move duty-free.
rules.sourceCitation: EAC Simplified Trade Regime, agreed common list and USD 2,000 threshold

rules.name: EAC preferential import duty
rules.reason: Goods of EAC origin accompanied by a valid certificate of origin enter other partner states free of import duty under the EAC Customs Union.
rules.sourceCitation: Protocol on the Establishment of the EAC Customs Union, Article 11

rules.name: Uganda value added tax on imports
rules.reason: VAT is charged on the customs value plus duty for consignments entering Uganda under full customs procedure.
rules.sourceCitation: Uganda Value Added Tax Act, Cap 349

rules.name: Customs processing fee
rules.reason: Administrative fee charged on lodging a full customs declaration.
rules.sourceCitation: Rwanda Revenue Authority customs fee schedule

rules.name: Phytosanitary / sanitary inspection fee
rules.reason: Charged for the inspection required before a phytosanitary or veterinary certificate is issued.

rules.name: Indicative road transport rate, Kigali–Kampala
rules.reason: Indicative shared-load road freight rate for small consignments on the Kigali–Kampala corridor via Gatuna/Katuna.
rules.sourceCitation: Indicative market rate; to be replaced by live provider quotes under FR-TRN-02
